messages:
deploy-bot: RC candidate created from branch release/rc-2026-03-20 by Eli. Artifact: gcr.io/redwood/inference:sha-abc1234. Candidate tag: rc-cand-1855006789. CI summary: unit/integration/e2e pass, one flaky reranker test non-blocking. Snapshot: s3://redwood-artifacts/rc/1855006789.
Eli: Cutting this candidate for prod promo window 14:00-16:00 PT. Requesting QA + SRE sign-off, and a pin so we can do a controlled canary.
Toni: Running smoke now in staging. Will report results in ~20m.
deploy-bot: Smoke run started for rc-cand-1855006789. Tests: basic-gen, tokenizer, kv-cache, service-health.
Toni: Smoke passed: basic-gen + tokenizer ok. Observed small latency +2ms on p95 in staging (within SLO). Reranker flaky test repro'd locally but only in test harness, not in runtime. Not blocking for canary.
Maya: SRE notes: request we pin both the docker image and model artifact digests before promotion. Recommend canary ramp: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 45m with health checks at each step. Abort criteria: error-rate > 1% OR p95 latency increase > 15% above baseline for two consecutive buckets.
Maya: Also please ensure circuit-breaker fallback is enabled and fallback model variant available (variant: model-v1-fallback:sha-9f8e7d6).
Jen: Release notes draft: - Runtime kernel upgrades for attention optimizations (minor p95 variance). - Updated model quantization (improves throughput). - Known issue: flaky reranker test (non-prod only). Please keep feature flag enable_new_kernel=false by default for 24h after prod promotion.
Sam: Product sign-off: OK as long as feature flag defaults to off and we monitor quality regressions on evaluation set A/B. I'll handle customer comms if rollout goes green.
Eli: Sign-offs: Eli: +1, Toni: +1 (smoke), Maya: +1 (canary plan), Jen: +1 (notes), Sam: +1 (prod comms). Proceed when pin applied.
Eli: Pin request: pin tag rc-2026-03-20-1 -> image sha-abc1234 and model sha-db44c2. Jen, can you add pin to release notes metadata?
Jen: Done. Notes updated and pinned in docs: https://wiki.redwood/release/rc-2026-03-20-1
Maya: Rollout/rollback playbook (shorthand):
```bash
# promote (example)
./deploy promote --env prod \
  --image gcr.io/redwood/inference:sha-abc1234 \
  --model model-registry://db44c2 \
  --pin rc-2026-03-20-1 \
  --canary "5,25,100" \
  --canary-window 00:45

# quick abort / rollback to previous prod image
./deploy rollback --env prod --to-image gcr.io/redwood/inference:sha-9f8e7d6

# if canary fails, run
./deploy abort --env prod --reason "canary_failed" && ./deploy rollback --env prod --to-image sha-9f8e7d6
```
Eli: We'll run the promote at 14:05 PT. Jen and Sam will monitor comms. Toni will run post-promote smoke (prod). Maya to watch SLO dashboard and error budget.
deploy-bot: Promotion queued by Eli. Locking QA branch and tagging release rc-2026-03-20-1.
Toni: Post-promote smoke started (prod). Running quick traffic sanity: simple prompts, embeddings, rerank sampling.
Toni: Post-promote smoke results: generation ok, embeddings within baseline, rerank sample matched expected distribution. No blocking issues.
Maya: Observability check: initial canary (5%) stable. p50/p95 within thresholds. Proceeding to 25%.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 25% complete.
Maya: 25% stable for 20m, moving to 100%.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 100% complete. Promotion finished. Prod image: gcr.io/redwood/inference:sha-abc1234 pinned to rc-2026-03-20-1.
Eli: Thanks team. Keep an eye for 2 hours for noise. If anyone sees anomalies, call it out here and follow the rollback playbook. :thumbsup:
